title: My Sister-In-Law Forged A Codicil, Sold Mom's Carousel, Sent Me $4,800. So I Voided The Sale
description: At 60, after 27 years as a school custodian, I returned to care for my dying mother. My sister-in-law forged a codicil, sold Mom's 1950s seaside carousel and snack pavilion for $910,000, and mailed me a $4,800 cotton candy check. Then I found Mom's real will inside a hollow carved-mane horse and voided the sale. #InheritanceFraud #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MOM'S CAROUSEL AND SENT ME $4,800
pinned_comment: If my sister-in-law forged a codicil, sold my mother's carousel for $910,000, and mailed me a $4,800 cotton candy check, what would you do, and has anything like this happened to you? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: LEFT ME A $4,800 COTTON CANDY CHECK AND TOOK EVERYTHING
